subject.title: [Feature]: Expose an inbound non-message event hook to external channel plugins (e.g. reactions)

question: Should external channel plugins surface non-message activity through the existing system-event/inbound-runner APIs, or should OpenClaw add a new public channel event hook/adapter contract?
rationale: The current code exposes partial primitives, but choosing a new plugin SDK surface affects third-party compatibility and overlaps with an open inbound_activity hook proposal.

options.title: Document current system-event path
options.body: Treat reactions and similar notifications as routed system events, document the recipe for channel plugins, and only add code if that recipe proves insufficient.

options.title: Sponsor a narrow event hook
options.body: Define a typed plugin SDK hook or adapter for non-message inbound activity and align it with the related inbound_activity PR before merging anything.

options.title: Defer until concrete plugin proof
options.body: Ask for a minimal Zoho Cliq plugin sketch showing why system events and runChannelInboundEvent cannot solve the use case.

recommendation.title: Document current system-event path
recommendation.body: Treat reactions and similar notifications as routed system events, document the recipe for channel plugins, and only add code if that recipe proves insufficient.

likelyOwner.reason: Most recent current-main provenance for the plugin SDK/channel runtime surfaces points to steipete, making him the best available routing owner for the SDK direction choice.
